fact.text: In 1940, Disney's Fantasia premiered in New York. It was the first commercial film shown with stereo sound.

heads_up: Penktadienį pajūryje vėjo gūsiai sieks 20 m/s, naktį keliuose – plikledis.

lithuania.headline: Dujos kitąmet gali brangti 46 %, elektra – 28 %
lithuania.summary: Gyventojams dujų tarifai kitais metais gali išaugti 46 %, o elektros – 28 %, beveik iki 2022 m. energetinės krizės lygio.
lithuania.context: 2022 m., Rusijai pradėjus plataus masto karą prieš Ukrainą, energijos kainos Europoje šoktelėjo rekordiškai, vėliau jos atslūgo.

lithuania.headline: Seimas atvėrė pagalbinį apvaisinimą netekėjusioms moterims ir poroms
lithuania.summary: Seimas 78 balsais už pakeitė Pagalbinio apvaisinimo įstatymą: gydymas prieinamas ir nesusituokusioms poroms bei vienišoms moterims, tačiau vaisingos vienišos moterys už jį mokės pačios. Prezidentas Gitanas Nausėda sako, kad įstatymą bus galima tobulinti.
lithuania.context: Iki šiol pagalbinis apvaisinimas buvo prieinamas tik sutuoktiniams ir registruotiems partneriams. Konstitucinis Teismas pripažino, kad toks apribojimas prieštarauja Konstitucijai, todėl įstatymą reikėjo keisti.

lithuania.headline: Ukraina neigia naudojanti Baltijos šalių oro erdvę dronų smūgiams
lithuania.summary: Ukraina atmetė Rusijos teiginius, kad jos dronai smūgiams į Rusiją skrenda per Baltijos šalių oro erdvę.
lithuania.context: Ukraina jau kelerius metus dronais atakuoja Rusijos naftos įmones ir karinius objektus. Šią savaitę Rusija apkaltino Baltijos šalis leidžiant Ukrainos dronams naudotis jų oro erdve, o į Lietuvą įskridusio drono NATO naikintuvai dėl prastų orų numušti nesugebėjo.

world.headline: Global Microsoft outage takes down Outlook and Teams
world.summary: Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services were disrupted for more than nine hours, with nearly 130,000 problem reports from 74 countries. Microsoft blamed servers that unexpectedly went offline and ruled out a cyber attack.
world.context: Last month an outage of Microsoft's Azure cloud also disrupted its tools worldwide.

world.headline: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
world.summary: Maryland senator Chris Van Hollen will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader in a secret-ballot vote in early December, the first contested race for Democratic leader in decades. Schumer says he has the votes to stay.
world.context: Democrats won a landslide in this month's midterm elections and will take control of the Senate in January with at least 55 seats. Schumer has led Senate Democrats since 2017, but many progressives blame him for the party's weak response during Trump's presidency.

world.headline: China holds unannounced Pacific drills aimed at Taiwan
world.summary: China staged unannounced military drills in the Pacific, which officials describe as 'silent intimidation' of Taiwan.
world.context: Taiwan has governed itself since 1949, when the losing Nationalists fled there after China's civil war. Beijing claims the island and in recent years has held frequent large drills around it.

world.headline: Indonesia's vice-president Gibran resigns over school diploma
world.summary: Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the son of ex-president Joko Widodo, resigned after the Supreme Court found no proof he had finished high school. Upper-house lawmakers have 60 days to pick a successor from two candidates named by President Prabowo.
world.context: Gibran became Prabowo's running mate in 2024 at 36, after a court waived the minimum age of 40 for him. Last month's court ruling led over 100 lawmakers to back impeachment moves, as the alliance between Prabowo and Widodo frays and protests over the economy and corruption grow.

interesting.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen in Search
interesting.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, which Google calls its biggest model upgrade to Search, is now the default in AI Mode and handles multi-part questions and typos better. Google says it is 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash; it is also in the Gemini app and API.

interesting.headline: Anthropic's IPO about six times oversubscribed
interesting.summary: Demand for Anthropic's share offering is about six times greater than the shares on offer, Bloomberg News reports.
interesting.context: Anthropic is the AI company behind the Claude chatbot.

interesting.headline: Harry Kane breaks England caps record
interesting.summary: Kane won his record 126th England cap and scored a penalty, his 92nd international goal, in a 2-1 win over Croatia that sent England into the Nations League quarter-finals in March. England play Spain in Madrid on Sunday.
interesting.why: Covered by BBC Sport and Al Jazeera
interesting.context: Kane was already England's all-time top scorer.

interesting.headline: Critics split on Johnny Depp's 'Ebenezer'
interesting.summary: Ti West's horror-tinged 'A Christmas Carol' adaptation, Johnny Depp's return to studio films, opens Friday with a 51% Rotten Tomatoes score; critics praise the supporting cast but split over Depp's Scrooge.
interesting.context: Depp has been largely absent from Hollywood studio films for years.

ongoing.title: Russia-Ukraine war
ongoing.update: Putin told US envoys Witkoff and Kushner he still demands four Ukrainian regions and would target any foreign troops in Ukraine; the envoys then briefed Zelensky in Dublin and said Europeans will join the next round of talks. A Ukrainian drone hit a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland, the first such attack in the open Baltic.
ongoing.context: It began in February 2022, when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Ukraine pushed Russian troops back from Kyiv and later in the north-east and south, but the front then settled into a war of attrition, with Russia holding about a fifth of Ukraine. Over the past year the US has brokered peace talks, most recently in Abu Dhabi.

ongoing.title: Nvidia CEO's affair with alleged Chinese spy
ongoing.update: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and board member; CFO Colette Kress is interim chief. Huang agreed to testify before Congress on Wednesday, and the shares fell more than 10% before trading opened.
ongoing.context: It began at the weekend, when the New York Times reported Huang's close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, whom US intelligence suspects of spying for Beijing. Nvidia's board launched an investigation, and on Wednesday a second affair, with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, was reported.

ongoing.title: US-Iran tensions
ongoing.update: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike on a telecom tower in southern Iran, their first claimed attack on US assets in the Gulf since September. Iran also said four tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz.
ongoing.context: Hostility dates back to Iran's 1979 revolution and its nuclear programme. A US-Israeli war on Iran began on 28 February 2026, with Iranian strikes damaging US bases across the region. Fighting later eased, but a US blockade continues and Israel is preparing for a possible new attack.

ongoing.title: Saudi Arabia-Houthi fighting
ongoing.update: Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi drones over the Riyadh region and Eastern Province; the Houthis say they targeted oil sites including the East-West Pipeline and Yanbu. The UN Security Council unanimously extended sanctions on the group for a year.
ongoing.context: The Iran-backed Houthis seized Yemen's capital Sanaa in 2014, and a Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015. A truce from 2022 largely held until fighting flared again this year, with Saudi-backed forces launching a new offensive.

ongoing.title: Hoax bomb threats across Europe
ongoing.update: 3,778 Italian schools got bomb threats on a second day, but only 77 were evacuated after the government told schools not to evacuate over a mass email alone. A bomb alert also delayed trains at a Calais station.
ongoing.context: Last week hoax threats hit airports and airlines in several European countries. On Wednesday emailed threats reached 6,300 Italian state schools and schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland; no explosives have been found.
